```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
pt_names = data.frame()
```

# Names that we DO NOT NEED 100%:
```{r}
remove = c("Northing", "Easting", "Feat_Name", "Datafile", "GPS_Week",
           "GPS_Second", "Point_ID", "Data_Dicti", "POINT_X", "POINT_Y", "Filt_pos", "Unfilt_Pos", "Treated",
           "Corr_Type", "Max_PDOP", "Horz_Prec", "Point_ID", "Max_HDOP", "Rcvr_Type", "Team",
           "Lifeform", "Nutrient_I", "GNSS_Heigh"	)
```


# Iterates through all point shapefiles, loads each dataset using `terra::vect()`, and extracts the year from the filename using a regex pattern (`[0-9]{4}`). It standardizes attribute fields by merging values from `Comment` into `Comments` when present and then removing the original `Comment` field. It removes non-essential attributes based on a predefined vector (`remove`) created in previous chunk. Finally, it compiles a long-format table of attribute (column) names with their corresponding year (`pt_names`), enabling cross-temporal schema consistency analysis and identification of naming inconsistencies."


```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
pt_names = data.frame()

for (i in 1:length(pt_files)){
  dat = vect(pt_files[i])
  dat_name = basename(pt_files[i])
  name_ind = regexpr("[0-9]{4}", dat_name, perl = T) # pull out the year from file name
  yr = as.numeric(substr(dat_name, name_ind, name_ind+3))
  
  if ("Comment" %in% names(dat)){
    x = which(!(is.na(dat$Comment)))
    dat$Comments[x] = dat$Comment[x]
    
    x2 = which(names(dat) == "Comment")
    dat = dat[, -x2]
  }
  
  if (any(names(dat) %in% remove)){
   x3 = which(names(dat) %in% remove)
   dat = dat[, -x3]
  }
  
  out = data.frame(year = yr, col_names = names(dat))
  pt_names = rbind(pt_names, out)
}
```

```{r}
# ── Position field audit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Checks if any file has both Position and PositionIn at the same time
# Result: no duplicates found, safe to rename Position -> PositionIn

found = FALSE

for (i in seq_along(pt_files)) {
  dat = vect(pt_files[i])
  nm  = names(dat)
  if (all(c("Position", "PositionIn") %in% nm)) {
    found = TRUE
    fname = basename(pt_files[i])
    yr    = as.numeric(substr(fname, regexpr("[0-9]{4}", fname), regexpr("[0-9]{4}", fname) + 3))
    v1 = trimws(as.character(dat$Position));   v1[v1 == ""] = NA
    v2 = trimws(as.character(dat$PositionIn)); v2[v2 == ""] = NA
    both = which(!is.na(v1) & !is.na(v2))
    diff = both[v1[both] != v2[both]]
    cat("\nYear:", yr, "-", fname, "\n")
    cat("Rows with both values:", length(both), "\n")
    cat("Rows with different values:", length(diff), "\n")
    if (length(diff) > 0) print(diff)
  }
}
if (!found) cat("\nNo Position duplicates found. Safe to rename.\n")
```

```{r}
# ── Photo field audit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Checks which photo columns coexist per file and flags real conflicts
# Real conflict = same row has different values in two photo columns
# Result 2023: Photo (663 rows) and Picture (59 rows), zero overlap -> safe to merge

photo_variants = c("Photo", "Photos", "Picture", "Link_Photo", "Photo_Link")

for (i in seq_along(pt_files)) {
  dat     = as.data.frame(vect(pt_files[i]))
  fname   = basename(pt_files[i])
  yr      = as.numeric(substr(fname, regexpr("[0-9]{4}", fname), regexpr("[0-9]{4}", fname) + 3))
  present = photo_variants[photo_variants %in% names(dat)]
  if (length(present) < 2) next
  cat("\n──────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat("Year:", yr, "|", fname, "\n")
  cat("Photo columns found:", paste(present, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  pairs = combn(present, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  for (p in pairs) {
    a = trimws(as.character(dat[[p[1]]])); a[a == ""] = NA
    b = trimws(as.character(dat[[p[2]]])); b[b == ""] = NA
    both_diff = which(!is.na(a) & !is.na(b) & a != b)
    cat("  [", p[1], "] vs [", p[2], "]\n")
    cat("    Only", p[1], "has value:", length(which(!is.na(a) & is.na(b))), "rows\n")
    cat("    Only", p[2], "has value:", length(which(is.na(a) & !is.na(b))), "rows\n")
    cat("    Both same value:     ", length(which(!is.na(a) & !is.na(b) & a == b)), "rows\n")
    cat("    Both different value:", length(both_diff), "rows  <- real conflict\n")
    if (length(both_diff) > 0) {
      conflict_df = data.frame(row = both_diff, A = a[both_diff], B = b[both_diff])
      names(conflict_df) = c("Row", p[1], p[2])
      print(conflict_df, row.names = FALSE)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ── Master cleaning chunk ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(terra)

# --- Simple rename dictionary: add new renames here as needed ---
rename_map = list(
  "Position"   = "PositionIn",
  "WH_Weevil_" = "WH_Weevil_Dam",
  "Weevil_dam" = "WH_Weevil_Dam"
)

# --- Photo variants to consolidate into Photo_Link ---
photo_variants = c("Photo", "Photos", "Picture", "Link_Photo")

# --- Columns to remove: add or delete names here as needed ---
cols_to_remove = c("Northing", "Easting", "Feat_Name", "Datafile", "GPS_Week",
                   "GPS_Second", "Point_ID", "Data_Dicti", "POINT_X", "POINT_Y",
                   "Filt_Pos", "Unfilt_Pos", "Treated", "Corr_Type", "Max_PDOP",
                   "Horz_Prec", "Max_HDOP", "Rcvr_Type", "Team", "Lifeform",
                   "Nutrient_I", "GNSS_Heigh")

# --- Extra columns with % besides cover columns ---
extra_pct_cols = c("Rake_Teeth")


# --- PositionIn standardization map ---
position_map = c(
  "Edge"   = "StartEnd",
  "Start"  = "StartEnd",
  "End"    = "StartEnd",
  "Middle" = "Center"
)

# --- Initialize empty list ---
pt_data_clean = vector("list", length(pt_files))

for (i in seq_along(pt_files)) {
  
  # Load each file individually to avoid terra pointer issues
  dat = vect(pt_files[i])
  
  # 1) Simple renames
  nm = names(dat)
  for (old in names(rename_map)) {
    if (old %in% nm) {
      names(dat)[nm == old] = rename_map[[old]]
      nm = names(dat)
    }
  }
  
  # 2) Rake columns: detect and rename automatically
  # Odd positions = species name, Even positions = cover percentage
  rake_cols = names(dat)[grepl("^Rake_Spe", names(dat))]
  if (length(rake_cols) > 0) {
    for (col in rake_cols) {
      pos      = if (col == "Rake_Speci") 1L else as.integer(sub("^Rake_Spec?", "", col))
      new_name = if (pos %% 2 != 0) paste0("Rspecies_", ceiling(pos / 2)) else paste0("Rcover_", pos / 2)
      names(dat)[names(dat) == col] = new_name
    }
  }
  
  # --- Convert to data frame once for all remaining operations ---
  crs_dat = crs(dat)
  geo     = geom(dat, wkt = TRUE)
  df      = terra::as.data.frame(dat)
  
  # 3) Photo merge -> Photo_Link
  present = photo_variants[photo_variants %in% names(df)]
  if (length(present) > 0) {
    if (!"Photo_Link" %in% names(df)) df$Photo_Link = NA_character_
    for (v in present) {
      src  = trimws(as.character(df[[v]])); src[src == ""] = NA
      tgt  = trimws(as.character(df$Photo_Link)); tgt[tgt == ""] = NA
      fill = which(is.na(tgt) & !is.na(src))
      df$Photo_Link[fill] = src[fill]
      df[[v]] = NULL
    }
  }
  
  # 4) Remove unwanted columns
  df = df[, !names(df) %in% cols_to_remove, drop = FALSE]
  
  # 5) Strip % from cover columns and extra percentage columns
  pct_cols = unique(c(
    names(df)[grepl("cover", names(df), ignore.case = TRUE)],
    extra_pct_cols[extra_pct_cols %in% names(df)]
  ))
  for (col in pct_cols) {
    vals      = trimws(as.character(df[[col]]))
    vals[vals %in% c("", "NA")] = NA
    df[[col]] = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", vals)))
    df[[col]][df[[col]] == -99] = NA
  }
  
  
    # 6) Standardize PositionIn values
  # Edge, Start, End, StartEnd -> StartEnd | Middle, Center -> Center
  if ("PositionIn" %in% names(df)) {
    vals = trimws(as.character(df$PositionIn))
    vals[vals == ""] = NA
    for (old in names(position_map)) {
      vals[!is.na(vals) & vals == old] = position_map[old]
    }
    df$PositionIn = vals
  }
  
  # 7) Standardize Preassigne values for 2022 and 2023 only
  # No -> NA | Yes -> Random
  yr = as.numeric(substr(basename(pt_files[i]), 
                         regexpr("[0-9]{4}", basename(pt_files[i])),
                         regexpr("[0-9]{4}", basename(pt_files[i])) + 3))
  if (yr %in% c(2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2021, 2022, 2023) & "Preassigne" %in% names(df)) {
    vals             = trimws(as.character(df$Preassigne))
    vals[vals == ""] = NA
    vals[vals == "No"]  = NA
    vals[vals == "Yes"] = "Random"
    df$Preassigne = vals
  }
  
  # 8) Standardize Revisit_ values for 2014 only
  # No -> Random | Yes -> Revisit | NA stays NA
  if (yr == 2014 & "Revisit_" %in% names(df)) {
    vals             = trimws(as.character(df$Revisit_))
    vals[vals == ""] = NA
    vals[vals == "No"]  = "Random"
    vals[vals == "Yes"] = "Revisit"
    df$Revisit_ = vals
  }
  
# 9) Create Assignment column for 2019 and 2020 based on Preassigne and newPatch
  # Preassigne=Yes AND newPatch=No -> Random
  # Preassigne=No  AND newPatch=No -> NA
  # newPatch=Yes                   -> New
  # NA stays NA
  if (yr %in% c(2019, 2020) & all(c("Preassigne", "newPatch") %in% names(df))) {
    pre   = trimws(as.character(df$Preassigne)); pre[pre == ""]   = NA
    patch = trimws(as.character(df$newPatch));   patch[patch == ""] = NA
    
    assignment         = rep(NA_character_, nrow(df))
    assignment[!is.na(patch) & patch == "Yes"]                            = "New"
    assignment[!is.na(pre) & pre == "No"  & !is.na(patch) & patch == "No"] = NA
    assignment[!is.na(pre) & pre == "Yes" & !is.na(patch) & patch == "No"] = "Random"
    
    df$Assignment = assignment
    
     # Drop source columns now that Assignment is created
    df$Preassigne = NULL
    df$newPatch   = NULL
  }
  
  # --- Convert back to SpatVector ---
  df$geometry        = geo
  pt_data_clean[[i]] = vect(df, geom = "geometry", crs = crs_dat)
}
```

```{r}
# ── Compare original vs cleaned cover values for ALL files ─────────────────────
# Reads each file from disk and compares against pt_data_clean

for (i in seq_along(pt_files)) {
  fname     = basename(pt_files[i])
  dat_orig  = terra::as.data.frame(vect(pt_files[i]))
  dat_clean = terra::as.data.frame(pt_data_clean[[i]])
  
  cover_orig = names(dat_orig)[grepl("cover", names(dat_orig), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  
  cat("\n──────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat("File:", fname, "\n\n")
  
  for (col in cover_orig) {
    orig_vals  = unique(trimws(as.character(dat_orig[[col]])))
    orig_vals  = orig_vals[!is.na(orig_vals) & orig_vals != ""]
    
    clean_vals = if (col %in% names(dat_clean)) {
      unique(dat_clean[[col]])
    } else {
      NA
    }
    clean_vals = clean_vals[!is.na(clean_vals)]
    
    # Flag if any value still has % or if lengths differ
    has_pct   = any(grepl("%", as.character(clean_vals)))
    flag      = if (has_pct) "  *** % STILL PRESENT ***" else ""
    
    cat("  Column:", col, flag, "\n")
    cat("    Original:", paste(head(orig_vals,  5), collapse = " | "), "\n")
    cat("    Cleaned: ", paste(head(clean_vals, 5), collapse = " | "), "\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ── NOTE: GPS Time Zone Verification Needed ────────────────────────────────────
# GPS_Date is read as POSIXct with UTC label by terra, but this does NOT
# confirm the GPS was configured in UTC during data collection.
# GPS_Time is stored as character in 12h format (e.g. 09:04:55am) with no
# timezone information attached.
#
# 
# Confirm with field team: what timezone was the GPS device configured in
# during data collection? (likely America/Los_Angeles = PDT UTC-7 in summer,
# PST UTC-8 in winter)
#
# If GPS was in local LA time -> add 7h (PDT) or 8h (PST) to get UTC
# If GPS was already in UTC   -> no conversion needed
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}
# ── Export all cleaned files to Excel ─────────────────────────────────────────
# One sheet per year, saved to your Box folder

library(openxlsx)

wb = createWorkbook()

for (i in seq_along(pt_data_clean)) {
  fname = basename(pt_files[i])
  yr    = as.numeric(substr(fname, regexpr("[0-9]{4}", fname), regexpr("[0-9]{4}", fname) + 3))
  
  # Read from pt_data_clean, NOT from disk
  df = terra::as.data.frame(pt_data_clean[[i]])
  
  addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = as.character(yr))
  writeData(wb, sheet = as.character(yr), df, headerStyle = createStyle(
    textDecoration = "bold",
    fgFill         = "#4472C4",
    fontColour     = "#FFFFFF"
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# ── Compare Preassigne, newPatch and Assignment original vs cleaned 2019 and 2020

for (i in seq_along(pt_files)) {
  fname = basename(pt_files[i])
  yr    = as.numeric(substr(fname, regexpr("[0-9]{4}", fname), regexpr("[0-9]{4}", fname) + 3))
  
  if (!yr %in% c(2019, 2020)) next
  
  dat_orig  = terra::as.data.frame(vect(pt_files[i]))
  dat_clean = terra::as.data.frame(pt_data_clean[[i]])
  
  cat("\n──────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat("Year:", yr, "| Total rows:", nrow(dat_orig), "\n\n")
  
  # Compare Preassigne and newPatch original vs cleaned
  for (col in c("Preassigne", "newPatch")) {
    if (!col %in% names(dat_orig)) {
      cat("  Column", col, "not found in original\n\n")
      next
    }
    orig  = trimws(as.character(dat_orig[[col]]));  orig[orig == ""]   = NA
    clean = trimws(as.character(dat_clean[[col]])); clean[clean == ""] = NA
    
    cat("  Column:", col, "\n")
    cat("    Original: "); print(table(orig,  useNA = "always"))
    cat("    Cleaned:  "); print(table(clean, useNA = "always"))
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  # Show resulting Assignment column
  cat("  Column: Assignment (new)\n")
  if (!"Assignment" %in% names(dat_clean)) {
    cat("    Assignment not found in cleaned\n\n")
  } else {
    clean_assign = trimws(as.character(dat_clean$Assignment))
    clean_assign[clean_assign == ""] = NA
    cat("    Cleaned:  "); print(table(clean_assign, useNA = "always"))
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```
